{{Quote|That Strato Driver's the fastest crate here.|[[Jord Dusat]]|<ref name="TTU">{{DroidsCite|The Trigon Unleashed}}</ref>}}
The '''Strato Driver''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model in use during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One such vessel was stolen from the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] by [[Jord Dusat]], [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]], [[Kea Moll]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] as they escaped from [[Sise Fromm]]'s [[Sise Fromm's stronghold|stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]]<ref name="TTU" /> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="P170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref>
